title: 10.1 A 77GHz Hybrid TDMA-MIMO Phased-Array Radar with 186m Detection Range and 3cm Range Resolution
problem: Current MIMO and phased-array radar architectures cannot simultaneously achieve long-range detection (LRR >250m), medium-range (MRR, 3-30m), and short-range (SRR, <10m) with optimal resolution for all three modes. Existing designs trade off maximum range vs. range/angular resolution across driving modes.
motivation: Advanced ADAS and autonomous driving require unified radar supporting all three detection modes with stringent requirements on range (186m), range resolution (3cm), and angular resolution without separate hardware for each mode.
method: This radar chip uses 8 transmitting antennas and 8 receiving antennas arranged in a 2×4 grid, all operating at 77GHz. It transmits frequency-swept radio signals (chirps) and listens for their reflections; by switching between different signal patterns, it adapts to detect objects at three different distances: long range (186m away), medium range (3-30m), and short range (under 10m), with 3-centimeter measurement precision. The transmitters take turns sending signals (a technique called time-division multiplexing, or TDMA), and the receiver antennas work together to focus and steer the signal electronically (MIMO beamforming), which allows the chip to find both distant objects and measure their precise angle from the radar.
key_novelty: The hybrid architecture combines time-division transmission (TDMA) with multi-antenna reception (MIMO) and adapts its signal patterns to simultaneously achieve all three detection ranges—long, medium, and short—from a single integrated chip.
contributions: Achieves 186m maximum detection range for long-range ADAS applications
3cm range resolution enabling short-range detailed sensing
Supports all three radar modes (LRR/MRR/SRR) with single integrated design
Fully integrated 77GHz FMCW phased-array with dynamic mode switching
limitations: Not discussed; scalability to higher frequencies or integration with perception systems not addressed.
primary_theme: Unified multi-mode FMCW radar via hybrid TDMA-MIMO
